rationale: The agent performed multiple order-changing actions (two exchanges and a modification) without first confirming with the user, violating the stated policy. It also only communicated the grill modification outcome and did not report the results of the helmet and luggage exchanges, leaving the request incomplete from the user’s perspective. While the agent appeared to identify the user via name and ZIP, the required pre-write confirmations were missing. Additionally, it provided refund and payment details without clearly supported tool outputs in the transcript. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
